name: LBR-9 stun rifle
description: The LBR-9 stun rifle was a type of stun blaster manufactured by BlasTech Industries, and was originally intended to be used as a sniper weapon for law enforcement and intelligence agencies. BlasTech used the DL-87 Firespray stun rifle as the LBR-9's starting point, and worked to increase the range, incorporating a longer barrel that featured an upgraded Galven-pattern, as well as a proprietary blend of blaster gases to achieve a coherent stun beam at range.
